rules.interaction: Does not apply where a local just cause ordinance adopted on or before 2019-09-01, or a more protective later one, covers the property; the local ordinance applies instead.
rules.title: Tenant Protection Act: just cause required to end a tenancy after 12 months (AB 1529 amendment)
rules.requirement: After a tenant has lived in a unit 12 months (24 if an adult was added), the owner may end the tenancy only for a stated at-fault or no-fault just cause. For no-fault causes the owner must pay one month's rent as relocation help or waive the last month's rent.
rules.key_value: just cause after 12 months; 1 month's rent relocation for no-fault
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies of 12 months or more (24 months if adult tenants added before 12 months); repealed Jan 1, 2030
rules.exemptions: Hotels, nonprofit/religious/care facilities, dorms, shared-bath owner homes, owner-occupied single-family homes and owner-occupied duplexes, housing with certificate of occupancy within 15 years, separately alienable non-corporate owned property with notice, deed-restricted affordable housing; local just cause ordinances (pre-9/1/2019, or later and more protective) apply instead
rules.quoted_span: after a tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied a residential real property for 12 months, the owner of the residential real property shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause

notes: Section was operative 2024-04-01 and last amended by AB 1529 effective 2026-01-01 (used as effective_date). Statute sunsets 2030-01-01. Local carve-out in (i) is encoded as yields_to for the five CA cities, consolidator should keep only those with their own just cause rule.
